name: browser-app-builder
description: Guide a student from local setup to a planned, tested browser app and GitHub Pages publication, with bundled Campus Designer styling.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, build, evaluate, and publish a browser app. No terminal experience needed.
interface.longDescription: Five guided stages help a student prepare a local project, agree a bounded plan, build an interactive browser app, test its calculations against independent examples, and publish source and a working demo on GitHub Pages. Campus Designer is bundled and used during Build for a shared Duke-inspired look without claims of institutional affiliation. This is an instructor-built pilot candidate; see the evidence and remaining validation gates.
defaultPrompt: Use setup-browser-app to prepare this folder. I have never used a terminal.
Use plan-browser-app to help me plan a pricing scenario calculator that runs entirely in the browser.
Use build-browser-app to implement my agreed PLAN.md with the bundled Campus Designer.
Use evaluate-browser-app to check my app calculations with me and record the evidence.
Use deploy-browser-app to help me publish my evaluated app on GitHub Pages.

io.github.jordanmeyer.label: Pilot candidate · Instructor-built
io.github.jordanmeyer.audience: MBA students building a self-contained decision tool, dashboard, or simulation with an agent. No prior terminal experience assumed.

results.label: Maintainer fixture calculation checks passed in the browser
Git freshness and publishing boundary checks passed

io.github.jordanmeyer.method: On October 8, 2026, the package installed in isolated Codex CLI 0.145.0 and Claude Code 2.1.86 configurations with all six skills, including Campus Designer. Maintainer-authored pricing and inventory fixtures passed 18 browser calculation checks; an intentional formula defect caused four failures and passed again after restoration. Nine Git/publication boundary checks and an independent instruction review were completed. These are local package and fixture checks, not student or ChatGPT Work trials.
io.github.jordanmeyer.limits: Pilot candidate. Requires host file, shell, and browser preview capabilities; no Python or Node installation is required. Fresh ChatGPT Work trials, clean-machine macOS/Windows setup, and live GitHub publication remain unverified. Public or synthetic project data only; no backends or external APIs. Design guidance does not grant institutional affiliation or mark authorization.
